evidence: The implementation report covers Package.swift, Sources/DiskStewardApp/**, and Tests/DiskStewardAppTests/** only, matching the node write contract.

StatusItemController configures the button to send leftMouseUp and rightMouseUp. StatusItemSurface maps left click to an NSPopover-hosted SwiftUI board and right click to an NSMenu; automated tests assert the routes differ.

StatusBoardViewModel calls VolumeSnapshotService, presents used/total/available capacity, refreshes on demand, and passes the current snapshot to SnapshotExporter. Its state/export test passed with a deterministic fixture.

The live --ui-smoke report listed Export Current Evidence, Settings…, About Disk Steward, and Quit Disk Steward. Source inspection connects each enabled item to export, SwiftUI settings/about windows, or termination.

The launch report returned status_item_accessibility_label=Disk Steward. Status button help, each menu item, refresh, disk usage, snapshot status, export, settings, and about surfaces have explicit accessibility labels or values.
Both source and automated test pin NSApplication.ActivationPolicy.accessory; the live launch report returned activation_policy=accessory.

swift run DiskStewardApp --ui-smoke launched the native status item, found a live volume snapshot, and emitted the expected interaction/accessibility report. A normal swift run DiskStewardApp process entered and remained in the AppKit run loop for the observation window.
swift test --filter DiskStewardApp passed 4 tests; swift build passed; full swift test passed 18 tests; git diff --check passed.
